title: Everyone is wrong about Kimi K3
description:
I put the new open-source model Kimi K3 from Moonshot AI head to head against Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 on one hard task: build a 3D spinning travel globe. An honest AI model comparison of the best open source AI model against the top US models, looking at speed, tokens, and real cost. See which AI coding model actually won, and why cheap per token is not cheap per job.

Get the full head-to-head breakdown here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1IwMC_9bXl8eW3fVUuww2MezJ-wrmTkbS2Oi3Eop0kLw/edit?usp=sharing
